name: mcp-obsidian
description: Interact with your Obsidian vault via the Local REST API community plugin
long_description: Lets Claude list, read, search, and edit notes in your Obsidian vault by talking to the Local REST API community plugin. Requires the plugin to be installed and enabled in Obsidian, with its API key configured below.

tools.name: list_files_in_vault
tools.description: Lists all files and directories in the root directory of your Obsidian vault

tools.name: list_files_in_dir
tools.description: Lists all files and directories in a specific Obsidian directory

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Return the content of a single file in your vault

tools.name: batch_get_file_contents
tools.description: Return the contents of multiple files in your vault

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for documents matching a specified text query across all files in the vault

tools.name: complex_search
tools.description: Search for documents using a JsonLogic query

tools.name: search_by_tag
tools.description: Search for notes tagged with a specific tag

tools.name: patch_content
tools.description: Insert content into an existing note relative to a heading, block reference, or frontmatter field

tools.name: append_content
tools.description: Append content to a new or existing file in the vault

tools.name: put_content
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file in the vault

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file or directory from your vault

tools.name: get_frontmatter
tools.description: Get the frontmatter of a note

tools.name: get_periodic_note
tools.description: Get the current periodic note for the specified period

tools.name: get_recent_periodic_notes
tools.description: Get the most recent periodic notes for the specified period type

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Get recently modified files in the vault

obsidian_api_key.title: Obsidian API Key
obsidian_api_key.description: API key from the Local REST API plugin settings in Obsidian

obsidian_host.title: Obsidian Host
obsidian_host.description: Host where the Local REST API plugin is listening

obsidian_port.title: Obsidian Port
obsidian_port.description: Port where the Local REST API plugin is listening
